title: Follow-up Automation
summary: A follow-up sequence with timing and a stop condition — not just one message.

sections.heading: Orientation
sections.subtitle: Beginning of the Lesson
sections.contentMarkdown:
- What Will You Understand? Follow-up is where sales can be lost — automation makes it systematic.
- Why Now? After the reception and WhatsApp — don’t leave anyone silent.

sections.heading: Tension
sections.subtitle: I replied once — and you went silent
sections.contentMarkdown: - "I’ll talk to him tomorrow" — a week has passed. The deal is gone.

sections.heading: Core Idea — Follow-up Sequence
sections.subtitle: Follow-up Sequence
sections.contentMarkdown:
- Day 0: Welcome, Day 2: Reminder, Day 5: Question — different goals.
- Stop Condition: Response, purchase, or cancellation.

sections.heading: Quiz
sections.subtitle: Quiz
sections.contentMarkdown:
The same welcome message again.
A gentle reminder through a different channel or a single question — not a sales pressure.
An instant call without a reminder.
